description: Call your local Ollama or vLLM model over MCP with schema-validated JSON output
name: io.github.setheerwagen/mcp-ollama-vllm

environmentVariables.description: Backend to use: ollama, vllm or openai
environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_BACKEND

environmentVariables.description: Model endpoint URL; must be local or on your own network. Required for the openai backend
environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token, openai backend only; sent as a header, never logged
environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional, openai backend only: embedding endpoint path
environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_EMBED_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Optional, openai backend only: auto, response_format or none
environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_SCHEMA_MODE

title: Ollama / vLLM Bridge
